positioningTips: Breeze flies LAS->RIC (~3x/wk), LAS->ORF (~2x/wk) and SFO->RIC (~2x/wk) NONSTOP - check breezeairways.com first; it does not appear in every OTA.
Frontier's own LAS->IAD daily nonstop is GoWild-eligible: get to LAS and it's ~$15 in fees home, then Metro+Amtrak or a ~2h drive to Richmond.
SFO->IAD on United runs up to ~9-10x/day - the frequency means good same-day rebooking odds, then Amtrak/bus to Richmond or Norfolk.
Flying into DCA/BWI/IAD is often much cheaper than RIC/ORF; finish with Amtrak Northeast Regional or FlixBus to Richmond/Norfolk.
Check RDU too - sometimes cheaper than RIC and a 2.5-3h bus/drive from Richmond.
